Phase 2 OUTSIDE tx: BroadcastManager::connection()->broadcast(channels, broadcast_as, envelope). EventContract::buildEnvelope + assertEnvelopeValid before broadcast. Phase 3a clears last_error; Phase 3b on Throwable releases dispatched_at=NULL + sets last_error; PayloadMismatchException → $this->fail() short-circuit.

cascades_traced.name: OrderStatusChanged — PENDING → ACCEPTED post-payment + Wave S-1 auto-prepare ACCEPT→PREPARING
happy_path: 1. Kiosk-cash path: PaymentService::confirmCounterPayment:193-360 inside DB::transaction. After lockForUpdate, sets payment_status=PAID, fiscal_sequence_no via FiscalSequenceService::next(), writes audit_logs 'order.counter_payment_confirmed' :312.

2. Wave S-1 auto-promote: if shouldPromote(ACCEPT,PREPARING) returns true for kiosk source_surface, OrderStatusChanged::dispatch(order, ACCEPT, PREPARING) fires at :343-348. DispatchableAfterCommit defers until commit.

3. Kiosk-card path: FrontendOrderService::finalizePaidKioskOrder :1212-1213 promotes PENDING → ACCEPT INSIDE the tx (after fiscal_sequence allocation), then :1238-1260 Wave S-1 dispatches OrderStatusChanged ACCEPT → PREPARING when source_surface=kiosk and payment via online TPE/CARD.

4. EventServiceProvider:117-156 $listen[OrderStatusChanged] order: [PersistOrderStatusChangedToOutbox, AwardLoyaltyPointsOnDelivery, SendFcmOnOrderStatusChange]. Outbox FIRST so loyalty/FCM throw cannot kill SSOT (F-002 truth-table).

5. PersistOrderStatusChangedToOutbox:27-58 idempotency_key = sha1(ORDER_STATUS_CHANGED|aggregate_id|old|new|correlation_id). Scoped to correlation so legit later transition with same (old,new) tuple in a different request still gets a fresh row, dup within request collapses (iter14 SPECIALIST-2).

cascades_traced.name: OrderCanceled — customer cancels / stale-pending auto-reject
cascades_traced.key_finding: OrderCanceled event is INTERNAL-ONLY (NOT broadcast). EventServiceProvider:170 $listen[OrderCanceled] = [ReleaseStockOnOrderCanceled, ReleaseAvailabilityOnOrderCanceled]. NO Persist*ToOutbox listener. KDS removes the card via the parallel OrderStatusChanged broadcast (status → CANCELED/REJECTED).
happy_path: 1. Customer self-cancel via FrontendOrderService:766 OrderCanceled::dispatch($frontendOrder) AFTER OrderStateMachine::recordTransition wrote the canonical audit row. Comment explicit on this ordering invariant.

2. Stale-pending: CleanupStalePendingKioskOrders job (cron schedule) finds 15min stale kiosk PENDING+UNPAID rows, OrderStateMachine::apply(REJECTED), then dispatches OrderStatusChanged(PENDING, REJECTED) + OrderCanceled (lines 79-82). Mail/SMS/Push dispatched in parallel.

3. Listener cascade post-I.4 HEAL: BOTH listeners wrap their body in try/catch with Log::error + RETURN (mirror DecrementStock WG-2 policy). I.4 RED I4-CONCERN-01 caught a stale re-throw in ReleaseStockOnOrderCanceled that would halt Laravel sync dispatcher and skip ReleaseAvailabilityOnOrderCanceled — now hardened. Divergent stock vs availability ledgers prevented.
4. Stock release idempotent via AvailabilityService released_qty ledger (F-01). Reuse safe.

5. KDS card removal: relies on the sibling OrderStatusChanged(*, CANCELED|REJECTED) broadcast triggering _debouncedRefresh → list() returns updated order, card filtered out via _isVisibleInCurrentBoard (CANCELED/REJECTED not in lane render set).
cascades_traced.concern_low: OrderCanceled-only path (no accompanying OrderStatusChanged) does NOT remove KDS card. Code-static review shows all call sites pair OrderCanceled with OrderStatusChanged (FrontendOrderService:752+766 / OrderService:1909+1918 / PaymentService:566+565 / CleanupStalePendingKioskOrders:79+82). VERIFIED — no orphan dispatch path found. Sentinel suggestion for V1.0.2: assertion that every OrderCanceled call site has a paired OrderStatusChanged dispatch in the same closure.
cascades_traced.verdict: VERIFIED CITED — I.4 HEAL holds, no new gap.

cascades_traced.name: Multi-borne concurrent — 2 bornes place orders within 2s, race on fiscal_sequence
evidence: FiscalSequenceService::next() triple defense: Cache::lock('fiscal_seq_b{id}', LOCK_TTL_SECONDS) → ->block(LOCK_ACQUIRE_SECONDS) → DB::transaction → SELECT MAX(fiscal_sequence_no) ->lockForUpdate() ->withTrashed() ->withoutGlobalScope(BranchScope). Z6-P1-WGS heal 2026-05-19 added withTrashed so soft-deleted Orders are included in MAX (sequence reuse prevented).
SQLite ignores FOR UPDATE (uses BEGIN IMMEDIATE) so tests pass; production MySQL takes a real row lock.
Cache lock release wrapped in try/swallow — double-release never masks caller's exception (good).
Sentinel: F.5 + H.3 verified per task prompt. F.5 was the multi-borne race scenario.

Queue number allocation (separate from fiscal_sequence) uses parallel Cache::lock('queue_lock_{branchId}_{businessDate}', 30) at FrontendOrderService:983-988 with ->block(15) + saveFrontendOrderWithQueueNumber retry loop (max 5 attempts on QueueException unique-violation, see :950-977). Two bornes within 2s converge serially without gap and without queue_number collision.
cascades_traced.concern_amber: On Cache::lock acquire timeout the code throws HttpException(409, 'Queue number allocation is busy. Please retry.') at FrontendOrderService:1011. Customer sees the kiosk error toast and may re-submit, idempotency middleware (X-Idempotency-Key) prevents duplicate persist within the same minute bucket. Recovery is sound. CONFIRMED by code path.
cascades_traced.verdict: VERIFIED CITED — concurrent race covered, no gap or sequence collision possible under V1 traffic envelope.

cascades_traced.name: Error path — kiosk POST fails (network drop mid-POST)
evidence: KioskPaymentComponent.vue:375 await this.submitOrder(...) — if AbortError or 5xx, throws.
Outer try/catch :434-445 catches, sets msg via err.response.data.errors flattening OR err.message OR i18n fallback kiosk.pay_screen.payment_error_generic. tpeWaiting=false / tpeCanCancel=false.

Order NOT persisted backend: if the POST never reaches the route or DB::transaction rolls back on Throwable, no fiscal_sequence allocated, no audit_logs row appended, no OrderCreated dispatched (DispatchableAfterCommit DROPS the event on rollback per app/Events/Concerns/DispatchableAfterCommit.php:30-39).

If POST PARTIALLY committed but response lost (network drop after server-side commit): customer retries with same idempotency_key + middleware returns the 2xx replay OR DB UNIQUE constraint on idempotency_key catches duplicate at QueryException :629-640 and returns existing order. C7 verified per task prompt.

KDS never sees a phantom order: the DispatchableAfterCommit invariant guarantees broadcast only after outermost commit succeeds. Sentinel OrderCreatedDispatchPlacementSentinelTest locked the placement of OrderCreated::dispatch INSIDE the transaction closure (Wave M / Heal Z2 P1 — 2026-05-19).
cascades_traced.verdict: VERIFIED CITED — DispatchableAfterCommit invariant is the linchpin; rollback drops the event; idempotency middleware covers retry.

findings.title: OrderCanceled NOT broadcast — KDS removal relies on paired OrderStatusChanged
findings.evidence: EventServiceProvider:170-173 OrderCanceled $listen contains only stock/availability release listeners. No Persist*ToOutbox. Grep app/Events app/Listeners for OrderCanceled broadcastAs returns ZERO results.
findings.rationale: This is by design — OrderCanceled is internal stock-release plumbing, OrderStatusChanged is the broadcast carrier. Every call site verified to pair both dispatches in the same closure (FrontendOrderService:752+766 / OrderService:1909+1918 / PaymentService:566+565 / CleanupStalePendingKioskOrders:79+82).
findings.v102_backlog_suggestion: Add sentinel test: assertion that every OrderCanceled::dispatch call site has a paired OrderStatusChanged::dispatch in the same closure (mirror PR-C T2 reframe pattern). Today this is convention-enforced; V1.0.2 sentinel makes it mechanically guaranteed.

findings.title: ws:heartbeat cache key TTL=120s vs admin polling 60s — observability dashboard freshness window
findings.evidence: DispatchDomainEventsJob:129 Cache::put('ws:heartbeat', now()->timestamp, 120) on every successful broadcast. SyncOverviewController:531 reads it for admin dashboard health pill.
findings.rationale: TTL=120s > 4x admin polling 60s — admin sees 'green' for up to 120s even if Pusher dies. Acceptable for V1 (chef sees Pret/EN COURS state visually in <5s on actual cards). For V2/SaaS multi-tenant, consider reducing to 30s to surface outages faster.
findings.v102_backlog_suggestion: If admin observability sensitivity needed, reduce TTL to 30-60s (still > polling cadence).

top_3_cascade_concerns: 1. AMBER: Multi-borne fiscal_sequence acquire timeout returns HTTP 409 to kiosk (FrontendOrderService:1011). Customer retries — idempotency middleware covers replay. Acceptable in V1 traffic envelope but a deliberate stress test of 50+ concurrent borne POSTs/sec on same branch would expose this. F.5 verified at lower throughput. Suggest V1.0.2 instrumented stress test 100/s to size LOCK_ACQUIRE_SECONDS optimally.

2. AMBER: ws:heartbeat TTL=120s observability dashboard freshness window — admin sees 'green' for up to 120s after Pusher death (kitchen sees real card states in <5s via polling fallback, so SAFE for V1 chef workflow). Recommend dashboard widget surfaces age-since-last-heartbeat instead of binary OK/KO.

3. INFO: OrderCanceled→KDS-card-removal coupling is convention-based (every call site pairs OrderStatusChanged). A future refactor that dispatches OrderCanceled without paired OrderStatusChanged would leave the card visible on KDS until the next polling cycle (60s admin / 5-15s branch staff). V1.0.2 sentinel test recommended (K1-F-01).
